sentences.text:
An Application For Anticipatory Bail ... vs Anup Dey @ Anup
Kumar Dey on 8 June, 2016

Bench: Patherya  1 Sl No. 37 08.06.2016 Rejected  pk  C.R.M. 2807 of 2016 In the matter of: An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on 07.04.2016 in connection with Nandigram Police Station Case No. 445 of 2015 dated 22.10.2015 under Sections 272/273 of the Indian Penal Code read with West Bengal Act 42 of 1973, Sections 3/328/304/120B of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 46AA of Bengal Excise Act and Section 16(3) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act corresponding to G. R. Case No. 1833 of 2015.
 And In the matter of: Anup Dey @ Anup Kumar Dey  ... Petitioner Mr. Amal Krishna Samanta ...

For the Petitioner Mr. Madhusudan Sur,
Mr. Manaranjan Mahata ...
On the prayer of counsel for the petitioner, this application is rejected as not pressed and dismissed.

Certified copy of this order, if applied for, be given to the parties on priori basis.
.
( Patherya, J.) ( Debi Prosad Dey, J. )
